Emily (People Ops): Quick q — I'll be starting an 8-week parental leave on 2026-07-01. I have 3 recurring customer demo slots (Mon/Wed/Fri) and a weekly 'product riff' call. Looking for suggestions on coverage and what info to hand off. cc @Ben
Ben (Manager): congrats!! :tada: We can rotate demos among the PMs and a sales rep. @Marcus can help on the external demo cadence. For riff calls, maybe record and pick highlight notes.
Marcus (Sales): I can take the Mon and Fri demos. Need a short script + product deck + list of pre-demo questions. I'm out Tue/Thu mornings though.
Tara (Product): I can cover Wed demos and lead the riff calls if someone shares the agenda 24h prior. Can you put the riff agenda template in the doc? Also brief on current roadmap asks to surface.
Sam (Eng): For demos that need live feature flags, provide a stable demo environment + exact flag settings. Also include any recent perf regressions to watch. Example snippet for runbook:
```
Demo env: staging-demo-v2
Flags: demo_new_pipeline=true, reduce_logging=true
Test steps: 1) Login as demo@redwood.com 2) Run sample customer prompt 3) Verify latency < 350ms
```
Emily (People Ops): Thanks — here's what I'll draft tonight: handoff checklist, script, deck links, test steps, customer context (open tickets), and preferred backup contacts. I'll add a calendar note to reassign invites.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Emily's handoff doc due in 3 days. View: https://docs.internal/redwood/handoffs/emily-parental
Ben (Manager): actionable asks: 1) drop scripts + links in the doc 2) add 'who to escalate to' per demo 3) record a 10m walk-through video for each demo
Emily (People Ops): I'll upload decks and quick vids. One thing — how do we handle customer-facing continuity if a demo needs feature we can't ship? Do we promise timeline or offer alternatives?
Marcus (Sales): Offer alternatives, never promise unshippable timelines. If feature pending, demo workaround + roadmap slide. I'll prepare a troubleshooting FAQ for common 'can't demo X' scenarios.
Tara (Product): I'll create a short 'known limitations' slide and pin in the deck. Emily, if you can list 2 priority customers who need special treatment, ping me and I'll draft tailored notes.
Emily (People Ops): Will do. Thanks everyone — this already helps. I'll post the handoff doc in the thread once it's ready. :heart:
